name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin fixes the CosyVoice3 win32 model-load crash (master e91a2a27, PR #124): cosyvoice_load_gguf built model_ctx (which holds a std::map) on the stack and returned it by value, which the @qvac/tts-ggml addon mixed MSVC-lib + clang link mishandled into a garbage map read and a load-time segfault; it is now heap-allocated to match chatterbox. Engine numerics are unchanged. It builds on the ggml-speech 2026-08-04 floor and the audiogen Metal placement change (PR #122), and carries CosyVoice3 + Parler iOS memory-peak fix (PR #121): map-in-place weight loading plus sequential lazy stage loading, CPU output byte-identical. It also carries PR #119 Parler Vulkan-on-Mali, PR #118 CosyVoice3 GPU path, PR #117 dl-safe backend init, PR #114 bounded Parler DAC decode, PR #110 Parler Vulkan, PR #103 Metal GPU, and PR #99 the original CosyVoice3 engine.
